LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Enlist_Letter_Label: Your colony now stands with the Mages Guild. Open the guild ledger at any settlement hosting them to draw pay, take work and see your standing.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Enlist_Button_Desc: Apply to the Mages Guild for access to its libraries, tutors and alchemists.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Enlist_Requrements_Not_S: The Mages Guild does not trust you yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Fact: You cannot join the Mages Guild while your colony is at odds with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Missions_Desc: See what work the guild has posted.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Menu_Missions_Desc: Open contracts posted by the Mages Guild. Accepting one costs nothing; payment comes when it is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Salary_Desc: Collect your share from the guild's steward.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Provisions_Desc: Take what the guild sets aside for its members on the road.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in the guild's keeping and collect them from any hall.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave the Mages Guild? Your standing will suffer for it.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Resign_Letter_Label: Your colony has left the Mages Guild. Its doors are closed to you for now.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Resign_Button_Desc: Give up your membership and every rank that goes with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Kick_Out_Label_Title: Relations have fallen too far. The Mages Guild has struck your colony from its books.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Work_0_Desc: Earn a stipend copying worn texts for the hall's library.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Work_1_Desc: Sit through the hall's lectures and take careful notes.
LanguageData.ESCP_MagesGuild_Work_2_Desc: Let the hall's restoration mages look after the caravan. The sick and wounded are tended now and then, and fight off disease half again as fast.
